# The Leaf link bitrate model (generated by model/bitrate.py)

Panel 1600 x 3200 = 5.12 Mpx at 240 Hz. Raw 10-bit 4:2:0: 18.4 Gbit/s.

Slices per frame: 16, each 8 tiles (one tile row). Slice wrapper (envelope, header, MAC): 53 bytes. FrameCommit: 109 bytes.

Per-batch ML-DSA-44 signing would add 9.5 Mbit/s and 480 signatures per second in U7. The KMAC tag plus one signed receipt per second avoids it.
